long_biography.plain_text:
David Tseng Van Lieu is a Hong Kong business executive with roles spanning operating management and corporate directorship across several decades. He serves as managing director of Supercraft (Hong Kong), a manufacturer and service company active in mainland China, Hong Kong and Taiwan.

His directorships have also included Van Lieu Co. N.V., a foreign profit corporation registered in Florida in 1986. The company remained registered there for more than two decades before withdrawing in 2010. During that registration, Lieu used a business address at Hong Kong's Great Eagle Centre alongside other company directors.
